notes.title: Moo Lander, the World’s First Mootroidvania, Is Now Available
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=g0Xdgrq2Oek;full][/previewyoutube]

Plovdiv, Bulgaria – May 27, 2022 – When the Sixth Hammer studio cow, kindly granted to us by the Bulgarian government, got her hoofs on Moo Lander for the first time, she was disappointed to find out the hero isn’t a space bovine hunter called Sa-Moos. Instead, that hero is you, a lone adventurer desperately fighting the boss taurus menace in a bid to save your home. Moo Lander is now available on PlayStation®, Xbox, and PC, with a Nintendo Switch version stampeding your way later this fall.

In Moo Lander, you play as civilization’s only hope, an explorer dispatched to ancient worlds, tasked with securing a continuous supply of the galaxy’s most potent energy source: milk. 

The lacteal mysteries of how this bovine marvel powers entire planets are not yours to understand. You have matters more important than pondering the galaxy’s workings anyway, namely, a herd of Mighty Cows determined to stop you at all costs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/1e555e4eaf051b719caa399f59e10f5f2f223e77.png[/img]

The journey takes you to bucolic pastures, sun-dappled forests, sinister swamps, and more, all hand-painted and stunningly beautiful – and each ruled by a Mighty Cow. The Sixth Hammer’s Cow AI powers Moo Lander’s Mighty Cows, making every encounter uniquely dangerous and fraught with tension. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/8c0f800c34a3bc340dbe9bab761ef2b76c255a7d.png[/img]

Granny Toxic blasts the air with poisonous fumes to end you, while the undead Necowmancer Lady Bones is summoned by ancient spirits to guard over the precious substance. Supreme Spider Cow – it’s a thing – uses her sticky webs and spit to control the battlefield. But none of them match the ferocity of the Cowger, always one step ahead of every other bovine creature. The reverend Ancient Mighty Cows cannot be fought with normal methods, though. You’ll have to use your wits and figure out non-lethal ways to tame these beasts.

 If you need a break from the main campaign, rustle up some friends and dive into Moo Lander’s moo-ltiplayer modes in couch co-op or remotely via Steam Remote Play. Take on the powerful Cow AI together or throw all the chips down in fierce PvP combat. Survive the Waves mode has you taking on cow-pious enemies on the battlefield. You can even play football with a cow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/e8904cd85d0d4cb491da133e5dcb39723881542c.png[/img]

[h3]Keep in mind that you can get your hands on the game with a [b]10% discount[/b] on the opening weekend![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/d3b2f9cfde8937edb9263e152385a8af7c4eaaab.gif[/img]
[h3]
Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] More than 16 Mighty Cow bosses 
[*] Emotional, 12+ hours-long campaign full of memorable characters and plot twists
[*] Unlock new tactical and combat abilities for your ship
[*] Take on advanced Cow AI and overcome their superior bovine intellect
[*] Discover beautiful hand-crafted landscapes, each with its own unique challenges, enemies, and puzzles.
[*] Team up with your friends in our diverse couch multiplayer
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/0e532c5e305e95bc0ddfd7e3a730319df23880d2.gif[/img]

notes.title: The world's first Mootroidvania drops in less than 20 days
notes.content:
Moo Lander hooves closer to release! The date is 27th of May, the place – Mars. Your mission, Landers, is to scour the unknown for the legendairy milk-generator device called Elwir. With it, you will be able to save your dying species from total extinction. 

But be careful with your quest – the Ancient Mighty Cows will bar your way and undermine your every moo-ve. Utilize your non-lethal arsenal for dealing with them, and everything else can be defeated with your deadly, lethal milk-powered arsenal. 

[previewyoutube=sEQbdtPD9_4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]One Final Demo [/h2]

In less than 20 days, the world’s first Mootroidvania lands, and with it – an epic adventure about cosmic milk and mighty space cows awaits the players. But before we offer you this journey, we would like to demonstrate the many features and virtues of Moo Lander with one final, updated demo. Experience beautiful environments, immersive self-recorded music and engaging combat. The platformer without any actual platforming is just around the corner – download one final demo and try it our yourselves. 

[h2]UI For The Ages [/h2]

We have completely reworked our UI, and this is a big deal. Just take a look at the new and improved visual elements of Moo Lander:

[previewyoutube=GCgbtQUcq20;full][/previewyoutube]

Every ability in the skills tree is explained with a short video, and every camouflage module is perfectly presented in the research panel. 

[h2]Improved Sound Design [/h2]

Moo Lander is completely voiced-over, with our own self-recorded orchestral music. We pride ourselves with excellent sound design for maximum gameplay experience and immersive playthrough. 

[u]Some other Moo Lander gameplay features include (but are not limited to):[/u]

•	Tame Mighty Cow Bosses in Glorious Cinematically Crafted Battles
•	Fight & Outsmart Highly Intelligent Enemies
•	Develop your Character and Unlock Powerful Milk Arsenal
•	Research your Foes and Unlock Powerful Passive Bonuses
•	Team with Your Friends in Our Diverse and Rich Couch Multiplayer
•	Experience an Epic Milk Saga with Memorable Characters and Emotional Twists
•	Explore a Fully Handcrafted World Teaming with Life
•	Immerse Yourself with our Epic Orchestral Music
•	Solve Ancient Puzzles and Uncover Long-Forgotten Secrets
•	Enjoy 12+ Hours Long Campaign

[previewyoutube=RaQhTn3XR6k;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/86b69ce12095394849da511c0330959c5e50c0f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/fb2548a4afa045ae8b654093350116cc6d92080d.jpg[/img]


[h2]The Mooltiplayer [/h2]

You are reading it right – Moo Lander has an awesome mooltiplayer, and we even give you the option to play as The Cow! How cool is that? The demo presents several special arena maps and three multiplayer mods – PvP, PvE and Galactic Mooball. Gather some friends to go up against the AI cows, or gear up and do a 2 Landers vs 2 Cows, all controlled by the players. Best enjoyed with a gamepad, the Moo Lander couch co-op moopltiplayer supports Steam Remote Play as well, so you don’t have to be in one room to enjoy some quality gaming time together with your friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/5ca921bd49f159f60ab633b45cebde65a3414a43.jpg[/img]

[h2]“Mars is one beautiful place!”[/h2]

With an upgraded art style, graphics, particle effects and shaders, Moo Lander will stun you with beauty and detail. Get to know our world better, immerse yourself within the strange planet that is Mars – with its lush flora, dangerous, but memorable fauna, environmental hazards, and last, but not least – The Ancient Mighty Cows. They protect the cosmic milk, and you aim to get it in order to save your dying civilization. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/9889377a4e1453ad0ba2c83b387a71165525f210.jpg[/img]

[h2]Demo Length [/h2]

With all that being said, the new Moo Lander demo is extended to about 25-40 minutes of intense gameplay, not including the mooltiplayer options. There are also three difficult levels added – easy, normal and hard. The last one being for those of you who fancy a souls-like challenge. Expect environmental puzzles as well, and many, many alien creatures along the way to victory. But you don’t have to be alone in this journey – you can invite some friends over to enjoy the 4-player couch co-op multiplayer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/a097c49f1b4a5b88216e753087efe31fa0db401c.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Join us once again while we are fighting with cows and spaceships in our office! All of the Moo Lander developers will join the stream to show you some singleplayer insights and multiplayer action!

[h3]Demo: Multiplayer[/h3]
You can also play [b]multiplayer[/b] with your friends locally or via Steam Remote Play.

Moo Lander multiplayer offers both [b]PvE and PvP modes [/b]– in the demo you can *Fight the Cow* ([i]up to 4 players[/i]), *Two Landers VS AI Cow* ([i]up to 2 players can try and defeat the near unbeatable mighty AI cow[/i]) and the signature Moo Ball - soccer with cows and spaceships!

You can choose to [b]play as a Mighty Ancient Cow[/b] with all the cool abilities that these majestic creatures possess. Test your cow instincts against the invading Landers and obtain a special multiplayer role base on your play style.

notes.title: The new and improved Moo Lander demo is here!
notes.content:
[i]During our Moo Lander development, we constantly strive to improve every aspect of the final product that is an indie game, including the demo element. Almost one year has passed since we release our second demo for the game, and now it is time to improve on it. 

[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/b8dabe74e992247047a4081306c5210aa153960d.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Presenting – The Moo Lander demo 3.0[/h2][/b]
We have several important improvements, as well as some small additions, all of which will be very subtle in the demo itself. If you’ve played the previous demo, you will experience the new one as something very familiar, but different (but still the same). Let’s dive into the specifics:

[h3]Milk Saber rework  [/h3]
[previewyoutube=rH0HO3uG2XU;full][/previewyoutube]

We know everyone’s favorite milk-powered weapon is the Milk Saber, but we felt that it was too powerful – one can slice and dice through everything with the fast movement of the weapon. We had to balance the sword with fewer and slower swings. Now you have a four-swing combo, and the last swing is more powerful than the previous, in a larger arc. We’ve added a cool camera shake effect to the weapon, so it feels heavier and more powerful. 

[b][h3]Milk Shield rework[/h3][/b][previewyoutube=fduI77T7vIs;full][/previewyoutube]

The Milk Shield was also not exactly what we were looking for, so we reworked it in an elegant way – upon milk shield activation, the player losses milk only once and has a 5 points counter on the shield. This means the shield can protect you five times, and after the fifth time it deactivates. Then you can simply activate it again, for the same cost of milk. If you keep the shield active, no milk is drained, and if you deactivate the shield with all the five points of the counter intact, you get some milk refunded. 

[b][h3]Three new unlockable skins added [/h3]
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/3d5c4c7f48e64c42be25c0650cf5140b4921c5ca.png[/img]

In addition to the one skin that was available in the previous demo, we have added three more! How cool is that! They are extremely hard to collect though, so we leave the figuring out to you guys.

[b][h3]Research panel rework [/h3][/b][previewyoutube=rk7fVqt2lpQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The old research panel was way too big and clunky, so now we’ve made it more practical, with all the info on the research materials you need. The passive bonuses of the skins themselves are also explained to the fullest detail. This way we also build upon the lore of our alien world of Landers and Mighty Cows. 

[b][h3]Skin perks rework[/h3]
[/b]We’ve redesigned the passive perks of the skins so that they are viable in the gameplay, interesting and really fun to use. You will enjoy the new skins’ passive perks in the demo, if you manage to find them that is. 

[b][h3]Overall visual improvements[/h3][/b][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/341c33ae245470728f1c9daaee42800e68c8b11a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/787d3047d55b32a010de164f0dc85f32904400cb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/1e555e4eaf051b719caa399f59e10f5f2f223e77.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/c6d897e826ea4ee2689e3ee1052fe78cb36319a9.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/ab475fce6344be1d80a548dd0870a020a2fdee98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/6a967c9a4b76e3da422b747bb1d99e0885358a9c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/498753c5050722084d971853643d6332b8cd5ce4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/23f1ce99a2a31ba0ed58b24500a0e5798a382a84.png[/img][/url]

We have enhanced our graphics even further, with some small additions of particles, shaders and practical effects when needed. You will be immersed in the world of Moo Lander with even more visual elements than before. 

[h3]Camera view fluidity [/h3]
It is important for the players to know what is going on during gameplay, and with all that flying around, it is imperative that our camera play is top notch. We have improved our camera views, achieving more fluidity in the process. The results are a smoother camera feel and enhanced overall gameplay flow.  

[h3]“Ask Hamilton” lore feature added[/h3]
[previewyoutube=u98LZ5hCNUo;full][/previewyoutube]
We felt our world is big and it deserves proper lore elements. That’s why we have added a special, optional feature – you can ask your ship’s AI, Hamilton, about the various flora and fauna of the game. During your first encounters with a new enemy or a neutral creature, Hamilton will brief you about its origins and purpose in the world of Moo Lander. You can skip these “lore drops” if you like, but you will miss out on some important information that will help you on your future adventures. And it is all voiced! 
[h3]
Tweaked difficulty levels[/h3]
Our three main difficulty levels are now – “cheasy”, “normal” and “legendairy”, and they truly count! If you want to fly your way through the demo, cheasy style, then the first option is for you. The normal option is just that – a balanced playthrough, not too hard, and definitely not too easy. And the last, legendairy option, puts you against the hardest of conditions. See if you have what it takes to take on that one! 

[h3]Harder enemy variations added[/h3]
Maybe the biggest addition up to now, we have added different, tougher variations of the demo enemies, corresponding to each of the difficulty levels. More health, more damage and more aggressive behavior – you will know them by the different color. 
[h3]
Galactic Mooball[/h3]
[previewyoutube=coMIwGL3Ivw;full][/previewyoutube]
Due to the popularity of our soccer mode, we have unlocked The Galactic Mooltiplayer mode! Play with up to three of your friends in a match of 2vs2 in several different arenas, lots of different mooballs, and don’t forget – you can play as a Mighty Cow! This new feature will add lots and lots of hours of fun to our demo,  and we hope you take advantage! 

[h2]The Same, but Different![/h2]
This will be the last demo for our fans before we release the full version of the game. We hope that we’ve managed to showcase all our unique gameplay elements to the best of our ability with this 3.0 Moo Lander demo. So don’t miss out and download on Steam now, experience the beautiful world of Mars and try to tame some mighty cows in the process! And remember – there is a Secret Cow Level, be part of it!

notes.title: Moo Lander’s first international Galactic Mooball competition is almost here!
notes.content:
[i]To celebrate our most successful multiplayer mode – The Galactic Mooball, and Moo Lander’s participation in Gamescom 2021, we have prepared something truly unique! Presenting – the first ever Galactic Mooball global competition. In order to make this happen, we are integrating leaderboards to Moo Lander’s special multiplayer mode, along with points system to see which Landers (or Cows) will score the most goals. Let’s dive into the details below.
[/i]

[previewyoutube=coMIwGL3Ivw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]
When do we start?[/h2]

The Galactic Mooball competition will be held exclusively during this year’s Gamescom!
•	[b]COMPETITION START: 25th of August[/b]
•	[b]COMPETITION END: 29th of August (included)[/b]
Between these two dates, our free Steam demo will be updated with this cool new multiplayer mode, which is basically a soccer simulation, but with cows and flying spaceships. You will earn points for each goal scored. As these points accumulate, the leaderboards will take shape with the Mooball champions on top!  

[h2]How to participate?[/h2]

Participation in the Galactic Mooball global competition is simple as one, two, three:
[b]1.	Download Moo Lander’s free Steam demo and install.  
2.	Get a gamepad ready.
3.	In the Mooltiplayer section, select the “Galactic Mooball” option. 
4.	Start scoring goals with your friends, either locally or via Steam Remote Play.[/b]

Every scored goal will earn you points in our leaderboards, which will be situated in the game’s [b][url=https://moolander.com/gamescom2021-competition/]website[/url][/b]. 

[b][h1]IMPORTANT NOTICE:[/h1][/b]
[b]For local co-op play only![/b] In the character’s screen, all participants [b]MUST RENAME[/b] their respective character and [b]USE THEIR STEAM NAME[/b] as a username. Otherwise results will not be valid. Names are [b]CASE SENSITIVE[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/d001a2118c294f056579f9b4fb6300eeb35387bb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/b43162d6e87d46eb194602df56d1e5eac013ba02.png[/img]
[h2]
The Prizes.[/h2]

If there’s a competition, then there would be prizes as well! In Moo Lander’s first global Galactic Mooball event, we’ve prepared substantial prizes for [b][u]the top five leaderboard players[/u][/b]. All of the 5 winners will get a key for the Extended Demo so they can continue playing Galactic Mooball as well as the future multiplayer modes after the competition ends. Along with this, here are the other prizes: 

[b]•	1st place - A special Moo Lander T-Shirt + 25€ Steam Gift Card

•	2nd place - 25€ Steam Gift Card

•	3rd place - 10€ Steam Gift Card

•	4th place - 5€ Steam Gift Card

•	5th place - 5€ Steam Gift Card[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/89bf15c34a97f9d79ae5e13e3f3bd7eb65df897d.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/0cf6fc5b26d22ad9dfd727631ea1f624eb270382.jpg[/img]
[h2]
Choose your side![/h2]

The Galactic Mooball multiplayer mode requires you to choose one of two sides – either The Landers or The Ancient Mighty Cows. These two factions have their own playstyle and abilities – The Landers handle the ball with The Milk Saber and are airborne the whole time, whereas the Mighty Cows stomp in front of them to tackle the ball, but are mostly grounded (which doesn’t mean they are helpless!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/48ae52b44393a6d9bcc18909ca1c4950832904b7.png[/img]

[h2]Choose your arena. [/h2]

Of course, every good galactic sport needs its own fantastic arena. You have a wide variety of different Galactic Mooball arenas, each with its unique terrain, environmental mechanics and obstacles. And to boot, we’ve added over 20 different soccer balls, each with a preset of distinct physical properties. All this guarantees that every single Galactic Mooball match will be a one of a kind experience! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/aa1b712093a4eb93cfc3712d3a8fc581965fde39.jpg[/img]

[h2]Time to Moo ball! 
[/h2]
Join us in our exiting adventure that is The Galactic Mooball Competition – play against your friends, test your mooball soccer skills, earn points and win rewards. Starting the 25th of August, only during Gamescom 2021, cosmic milk and mighty cows will await you in Moo Lander’s first ever global competition! And with your help, we can make this an Moolympic sport ;)

notes.title: Moo Lander short Documentary out now
notes.content:
[i]Every game need a good explanation, especially and indie game! What’s the main idea of the game, the plot, the machanics, gameplay, cool features… With all this in mind, we at The Sixth Hammer game studio have decided to make our own short documentary video, explaining the most important details of Moo Lander. [/i]

[previewyoutube=RaQhTn3XR6k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]It’s All About The Milk! [/h2]

Milk is an essential part of Moo Lander’s gameplay mechanics. The abilities you use ingame, the plot and the milky effects are all based on this most precious universal resource. Learn more about this cosmic milk and why it is so important for the game’s main hero. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/03902dc50c17d5ba44ab50babbc3c23e0ceb927e.jpg[/img]
[h2]
We have Mooltiplayer[/h2]

What’s a fun game without a family friendly couch co-op? We’ve got some really cool multiplayer local modes – like PvP, PvE, cow chases, survive the waves, and the most interesting one – The Galactic Mooball! It’s all explained in the short Documentary. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/a2bcf8484a69c7fea1b2d3bcb23dd3a19a4e633e.png[/img]
[h2]
Ancient Mighty Cows[/h2]

We pride ourselves with our Ancient Mighty Cows! Over 20 of them will be waiting in Moo Lander – every single one with its own unique abilities, special attacks and behavior. After all, we have crafted a special AI just for the cows. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/05a20034850646b5aaeee6091f6ed37fe04c750f.jpg[/img]
[h2]
There IS a Cow Level 
[/h2]

Whoever said “there is no cow level” clearly didn’t understand cosmic milk and universal cows. In Moo Lander, there is, indeed, a cow level – in fact, every level is a cow level. You can be a part of it, just [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080040/Moo_Lander/]hop in on the action and start taming those mighty cows[/url].

notes.title: Moo Lander’s Mooltiplayer
notes.content:
[i]What’s a fun game without a family friendly competition? Moo Lander has its own couch co-op Mooltiplayer, supporting up to four players at a time. Discover several different PvP and PvE modes, brutal combats, cow chases, and you can even play as the cows! [/i]
 
[h3][b]Moortal Combat![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/2aa3de2f1668c1348ec5b21077539256681626e0.jpg[/img]

With battles being so hilariously epic, the only thing left to do was bringing multiplayer to the table. Or should we say - to the couch! We just *had* to give our players the option to [b][u]play as an Ancient Mighty Cow![/u][/b] 

You can expect up to four different modes of 4-player couch co-op multiplayer (two of them are already available in the demo): 
•	[b]Fight The Cow[/b] – Players can fight for dominion with up to 2 Landers and 2 Cows;
•	[b]Two Landers VS AI Cow[/b] – Up to 2 players can try and defeat the near unbeatable mighty AI cow; 
•	[b]Chase the Cow[/b] – 1 VS 1 challenge in which the fastest one wins; 
•	[b]Survive the waves[/b] – A co-op adventure for up to 2 Landers and 2 cows.
•	[b]Milk Ball[/b] – Football where the cows are goalkeepers and the Landers attackers

[h3][b]Choose Your Bovine[/b][/h3]

Our multiplayer gives access to three different Mighty cows for you to play with. Each of these cows has her own special attacks in addition to the basic bovine abilities. These three cows are The Frozen Cow, The Vanilla Cow and The Universal Cow. The full release of Moo Lander will offer the complete roster of over 16 Mighty Cows, with their special attacks, appearance and AI behavior. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/bf92d398eb988fbde1bcd124e54c171d8591e744.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/e5f4625d732f0b87ce399b770ec8010e12095db2.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Choose Your Arena [/b][/h3]

Four hand-crafted arenas are available to play in the demo, but the full release offers over 20 completely unique [b]Mooltiplaye[/b]r battle arenas. Each of these can be played using the 4 different modes, which makes for an extremely high number of possibilities to have fun with your friends and family. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/c018122c1d54fe3be692d1b8d44ac4063fadc522.png[/img]

The multiplayer supports Steam Remote Play as well, so you won’t have to be using a hot seat or be in the same place as your gaming buddies. So grab a gamepad, challenge a friend to a cow duel and start the fun – our demo on Steam is completely free! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/07097bbc9bf20d2f696e3671a4ffe4aaff029613.png[/img]

[h3][b]Be Competitive[/b][/h3]

Moo Lander’s multiplayer is unique in a certain way – there are different roles, which the players can unlock during a multiplayer session. Five roles are there for the Landers, and five for the Mighty Cows, but only one will rule them all in the end of a battle! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069718/c1125f68e7929e3eb9539a143e3b63da712671f8.png[/img]

The roles themselves are unlocked when a player does a certain thing enough times during a battle. For example, if a Lander player is taking enormous amount of damage, he will unlock the “Tank” role, which makes him more resistant to cow damage. There is a catch though – when you unlock a role, all other roles become unavailable to you. The role is set in stone until the end of the battle. So choose your strategy wisely and combine forces with your teammate – create unique double playstyles when going up against hardcore Mighty Cows. 


[u][b]Lander roles:[/b][/u]
•	Bombotron – drop bombs faster.
•	The Electrocutionist – faster zap charge rate.
•	The Knocker – increased stun time.
•	The Tank – decreased damage taken.
•	The Doctor – more health from pickups. 

[u][b]Cow roles:[/b][/u]
•	Slick and Slimy – increase spit rate.
•	Hooves of steel – increased stun time.
•	The Mighty Spikey – increase stab damage. 
•	The Tank – decreased damage taken.
•	The Gobbler – more health from eating grass.

[previewyoutube=S5EKokPLWEk;full][/previewyoutube]


[b][h3][b]Pump Those Numbers Up![/b][/h3][/b]
Players have one more thing to consider during a multiplayer session – the multiplier numbers – whenever you do damage to your opponent, you gain experience points, and the longer you avoid taking damage, the higher the multiplier becomes. For example, if a Lander does damage to a Mighty Cow for a certain period of time without taking any damage, he gets a multiplier of x2, then x3, all the way up to x10! At the end of each multiplayer match, there will be a mini-leaderboard with the highest grossing experienced players.  

[b]So pump those numbers up, don’t be a rookie! [/b]

notes.title: Exclusive E3 Demo
notes.content:
[i]Moo Lander has it all – unlockable battle abilities, worthy enemy AI, Cow boss battles, beautiful art style, self-recorded orchestral music, RPG elements, multiplayer and lots and lots of milk! And now you can experience these features with our new free demo on Steam![/i]

[previewyoutube=A4pLMX-YGmA;full][/previewyoutube]

We have prepared a special demo build for this year’s E3 event – bigger, better, more beautiful than ever, more challenging than before! With a 15 to 25 minutes singleplayer campaign and almost limitless multiplayer fun with the two cool modes – PvP and PvE. 

[h1]Unlock Them All! [/h1]
Since our last demo iteration of Moo Lander, we have added awesome new features to the game – camouflage modes and Lander tech. Now you can unlock The Milk Shield, used to block enemy fire and deflect special projectiles, The Milk Saber to slash away at every hostile creature out there, and a completely new gameplay system – the camouflage modes! The full release is filled with all kinds of cool milk-based weapons and milk arsenal, so hang tight to 2022. 

[h1]The Ancient Mighty Cows[/h1]
The cow bosses we call “The Ancient Mighty Cows” are back! And with brand new rework to our home-brewed cow AI no less. You can expect angrier, harder cows to battle, both in the Mooltiplayer arenas and in the signleplayer endgame. We’ve added some interesting cow species to the mooltiplayer choices, where you can play as the cow! Challenge yourself with our multi-phase cow boss battle, master The Lander’s tech to defeat them. 

[h1]Demo Length [/h1]
With all that being said, the new Moo Lander demo is extended to about 25-minutes of intense gameplay, not including the mooltiplayer option. We’ve also added three difficult levels – easy, normal and hard. The last one being for those of you who fancy a souls-like challenge. Expect environmental puzzles as well, and many, many alien creatures along the way to victory. But you don’t have to be alone in this journey – you can invite over some friends to enjoy the 4-player couch co-op multiplayer! 

[h1]The Mooltiplayer [/h1]
You are readying it right – we have an awesome mooltiplayer in Moo Lander, and it gives you the option to play as The Cow! How cool is that? The demo presents several special arena maps and two multiplayer mods – PvP and PvE. Gather some friends to go up against the AI cows, or gear up and do a 2 Landers vs 2 Cows, all controlled by the players. Best enjoyed with a gamepad, the Moo Lander couch co-op moopltiplayer supports Steam Remote Play as well, so you don’t have to be in one room to enjoy some quality gaming time together with your friends. 

[previewyoutube=S5EKokPLWEk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]“Mars is one beautiful place!”[/h1]
With an upgraded art style, graphics, particle effects and shaders, Moo Lander will stun you with beauty and detail. Get to know our world better, immerse yourself within the strange planet that is Mars – with its lush flora, dangerous, but memorable fauna, environmental hazards, and last, but not least – The Ancient Mighty Cows. They protect their milk, you aim to get it in order to save your dying civilization. All this – accompanied by self-recorded orchestral music. 

[previewyoutube=cumUlHJLOZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Moo Lander Demo - Steam Game Festival Announcement
notes.content:
So let us tell you more about the alien world of Moo Lander:
[b]The milk[/b] resource is the primary goal of the protagonist, it is the single most powerful resource in the universe. Everything revolves around the milk and [b]cows[/b].

The story unfolds millions of years ago where you can see a lot of alien creatures and enemies. 
The art is inspired by games like Ori and the Blind Forest and Rayman Legends. The alien world of Moo Lander is presented with high-detail gorgeous visuals, handcrafted environments and hours of composed orchestral music, that will magnify the immersion in this amazing universe.


[h3]Demo: Singleplayer[/h3]
In the demo you will be able to play through a 15 minutes "showreel" singleplayer campaign. You will unlock a few abilities and encounter different intelligent enemies that you need to outsmart. Of course that you will have to deal with our [b]ancient mighty boss cow[/b] at the end!

[h3]Demo: Multiplayer[/h3]
You can also play [b]multiplayer[/b] with your friends locally or via Steam Remote Play.

Moo Lander multiplayer offers both [b]PvE and PvP modes [/b]– in the demo you can *Fight the Cow* ([i]up to 4 players[/i]) and *Two Landers VS AI Cow* ([i]up to 2 players can try and defeat the near unbeatable mighty AI cow[/i]).

You can choose to [b]play as a Mighty Ancient Cow[/b] with all the cool abilities that these majestic creatures possess. Test your cow instincts against the invading Landers and obtain a special multiplayer role base on your play style. 

[previewyoutube=iMOqABN08Ks;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]THE MIGHTY COWS[/h3]
The cows are ancient mighty creatures that will threaten your mission. We have developed an advanced Cow AI and you will need to master your skills in order to match their superior intellect!

[h3]INTELLIGENT ENEMIES[/h3]
Over 20 different types of enemies with deadly attacks are always waiting around the corner! Their mission – to prevent you from achieving yours. Each one of them requires a unique approach in order to be defeated.

[h3]STORY[/h3]
Milk - the purest energy source, rivaled by the brightest hypernovas, has been lost after The War! Your mission is to recover ancient device capable of producing infinite amounts of it. Play through rich storyline filled with a lot of unexpected plot twists and branching conversations.

[h3]UPGRADE YOUR SHIP[/h3]
During the course of your game you will constantly unlock new tactical and combat abilities. You can then further upgrade them in a way that shapes your specific playstyle.

[h3]HANDCRAFTED ENVIRONMENT[/h3]
Discover beautiful, yet lethal hand-crafted landscapes with stunning visual details. During your journey you will go through many different terrains – each with its own unique challenges, enemies and puzzles.

[h3]COUCH MULTIPLAYER[/h3]
Old school couch multiplayer for your friends and family - fighting against our powerful Cow AI, having a brutal PvP combats, jumping into fast-paced cow chases or teaming against our intelligent enemies - there is a lot to explore in the multiplayer of Moo Lander.


[b]Have fun playing, and may the milk be with you! [/b]
